template_metadata.description: Template for documenting functional architecture: flows, functions, and dependencies
template_metadata.usage: Copy this template to specs/functional/functional_architecture.json and populate with your system's functional decomposition

user_scenarios: {List user scenario IDs this flow supports}
entry_functions: {List function IDs that start this flow}
exit_functions: {List function IDs that complete this flow}
functional_flows.context_consumption_estimate: {For AI workflows: estimated tokens consumed by this flow}

functional_flows.description: Handles user login: receives credentials, validates, creates session

functions.function_type: {read | write | process | decide | generate | validate | iterate}

error_handling.error_handler_function: {Function ID that handles errors from this function}

functions.context_consumption: {For AI workflows: estimated tokens consumed by this function}
requirements_satisfied: {List requirement IDs this function helps satisfy}

functions.description: Checks if username and password match stored credentials
functions.notes: Passwords must be hashed before comparison

dependencies.weight: {For AI workflows: context consumption of this transition}

dependencies.description: F-001 calls F-002 to validate credentials
If validation succeeds, proceed to create session
If validation fails, trigger error handler

entry_points: {List of function IDs that are entry points (no incoming edges)}
exit_points: {List of function IDs that are exit points (no outgoing edges)}
dag_properties.average_fan_out: {Average number of outgoing edges per function}
dag_properties.average_fan_in: {Average number of incoming edges per function}

context_analysis.applicable: {true if AI workflow with context tracking, false otherwise}
context_analysis.total_context_budget: {For AI workflows: total available context (e.g., 200000 tokens)}

context_consumption_paths.path_description: {Description of this path through the functions}
context_consumption_paths.cumulative_context: {Sum of context consumption along this path}
context_consumption_paths.bottleneck: {true if this path is a context bottleneck}

context_optimization_opportunities: {List functions or paths that could be optimized to reduce context consumption}

llm_agent_guidance.decomposition_approach: 1) Identify functional flows from user scenarios, 2) Decompose each flow into atomic functions (single responsibility), 3) Define inputs/outputs for each function, 4) Map function dependencies (create DAG), 5) Optionally estimate context consumption (AI workflows)
llm_agent_guidance.function_granularity: Functions should be ATOMIC - perform ONE specific task. If a function does multiple things, split it into multiple functions.
llm_agent_guidance.dag_requirement: The dependency graph MUST be acyclic (DAG). No circular dependencies (F-001 → F-002 → F-001). Cycles indicate design flaw.
llm_agent_guidance.context_tracking: For AI agent workflows, track context consumption to ensure workflows fit within available context window (e.g., 200k tokens for Claude Sonnet 4.5).
